`interface IFrameBuffer`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`FrameBufferHandle`](/reference/bridges/framebufferhandle/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.framebuffer` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IFrameBuffer.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/framebuffer/IFrameBuffer.java)

An offscreen target of the render bridge, with a color texture and a depth buffer.

## Description

[`FrameBufferPool`](/reference/drawing/framebufferpool/) lends them to the core, and `RenderState.frameBuffer(...)` makes one the target.

## Learn more

- [Framebuffers and depth](/build/framebuffers-and-depth/)
